cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Comfort Everyone Else
cards.instruction: Meet every painful moment by comforting someone else more intensely while your own distress becomes harder to hide.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll get you settled. I've brought tissues; being laid off together doesn't make your day any easier.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're wiping your eyes on your sleeve.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm saving the soft ones for you. Tell me what you're worried about.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You. You can't even get the tissue box open.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Open it for me, then take what you need. I'll make tea when my hands stop shaking.

reason: Give A a practical concession to B help with the box while A continues redirecting care toward B; make shaking explicit instead of depending on unseen hands doing this.
